```c
ret = dev_err_probe(dev, PTR_ERR(led->gpiod), "led: get gpio fail!\n");

```c
ret = sso_create_led(priv, led, fwnode_child);
```
```c
return ret;
```

The second statement captures the return value of `sso_create_led`, ensuring that any error from this function is also propagated. Finally, the return statement now returns the value of `ret`, which accurately reflects the outcome of the function, allowing the caller to handle errors appropriately.
